steps.instruction: Put a large pan on a medium heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Slice {{ing:leek}} and chop {{ing:onion-medium}}. Fry 10 minutes, until soft but not brown.
Peel and dice {{ing:potato-medium}}. Add with {{ing:stock-vegetable}}.
Simmer 20 minutes, until the potato is soft.
Blend until smooth.
Snip {{ing:chives}} over the top.

recipes.name: French onion soup with cheese toasts

steps.instruction: Melt {{ing:butter-unsalted}} in a large pan on a low heat.
Slice {{ing:onion-large}} thinly. Add with {{ing:sugar-caster}}.
Cook 40 minutes, stirring now and then, until deep golden.
steps.note: Slow is the point. High heat burns them bitter.

steps.instruction: Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Add {{ing:wine-white}}, {{ing:stock-vegetable}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}.
Simmer 20 minutes.
Toast {{ing:sourdough}}. Top with grated {{ing:gruyere}}. Grill until bubbling. Float on the soup.

swaps.text: Most Gruyère is made with animal rennet; use a vegetarian Alpine-style cheese if that matters

steps.instruction: Dice {{ing:lamb-leg}}. Put in a large pan with 1.5 litres of water and {{ing:stock-cube}}.
Rinse {{ing:pearl-barley}}. Add. Simmer 40 minutes.
Dice {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:carrot-medium}}, {{ing:swede}} and {{ing:leek}}. Add.
Simmer 30 minutes more, until the barley and vegetables are tender.
Stir in chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
Simmer {{ing:stock-chicken}} and {{ing:ginger-fresh}} in a pan.
Slice {{ing:chicken-breast-skinless}} thinly. Add. Simmer 6 minutes, until cooked.
Add drained {{ing:sweetcorn-tinned}} and {{ing:soy-sauce}}.
Mix {{ing:cornflour}} with 3 tbsp cold water. Stir in until the soup thickens.
Beat {{ing:egg-medium}}. Pour in slowly, stirring, so it sets in ribbons.
Scatter with sliced {{ing:spring-onion}}.

recipes.name: Orange, fennel and olive salad
recipes.method_note: Blood oranges, when you can find them in January, make it.

steps.instruction: Cut the peel and pith off {{ing:orange}}. Slice into rounds.
Slice {{ing:fennel-bulb}} and {{ing:red-onion}} very thinly.
Arrange on a plate with {{ing:olives-pitted}}.
Drizzle with {{ing:olive-oil}}. Scatter {{ing:fresh-mint}} leaves.
Heat the grill to high.
Grate {{ing:cheddar-cheese}}. Mix with {{ing:mustard-dijon}}, {{ing:milk-whole}}, {{ing:egg-yolk}} and {{ing:cayenne-pepper}}.
Toast {{ing:bread-slice-medium}} on one side.
Spread the cheese on the untoasted side.
Grill 3 minutes, until bubbling and browned.
Melt {{ing:butter-unsalted}} in a pan. Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}. Fry 6 minutes.
Dice {{ing:potato-medium}}. Add with {{ing:milk-whole}}.
Simmer 12 minutes, until the potato is tender.
Add {{ing:haddock-smoked}} in chunks and drained {{ing:sweetcorn-tinned}}.
Simmer 5 minutes, until the fish flakes.
Stir in chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
Put a frying pan on a medium heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Slice {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Fry with {{ing:chilli-flakes}} 1 minute, until pale gold.
Turn up the heat. Add {{ing:king-prawns-raw}}. Cook 3 minutes, until pink.
Scatter with chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
Serve sizzling with {{ing:sourdough}} for the oil.
Heat the oven to 160C. Dice {{ing:beef-braising}}. Toss in {{ing:flour-plain}}.
Brown in {{ing:olive-oil}} in a casserole, in batches. Lift out.
Chop {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:carrot-medium}}. Fry 8 minutes.
Add {tomato-purée}, {{ing:stock-cube}} in 800 ml water and {{ing:bay-leaf}}. Return the beef. Cover.
Cook in the oven 2 hours.
Mix {{ing:flour-self-raising}} and {{ing:suet-vegetable}} with cold water to a soft dough.
Roll into 8 balls. Sit on the stew. Cook uncovered 25 minutes, until risen.

recipes.name: Toad in the hole with onion gravy
recipes.method_note: The fat must be smoking hot when the batter goes in, or it will not rise.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 220C. Put {{ing:sausage-pork}} and {{ing:vegetable-oil}} in a roasting tin.
Roast 10 minutes.
Whisk {{ing:flour-plain}}, {{ing:egg-medium}} and {{ing:milk-whole}} to a smooth batter.
Pour round the sausages at once, while the fat is sizzling.
Bake 30 minutes, until risen and golden. Do not open the oven.
Fry sliced {{ing:onion-medium}} 15 minutes until soft. Add {{ing:gravy-granules}} with 500 ml boiling water.
Heat the oven to 170C. Dice {{ing:lamb-leg}}. Brown in {{ing:olive-oil}}. Lift out.
Slice {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:carrot-medium}}. Fry 8 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Add {{ing:stock-cube}} in 500 ml water and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}.
Return the lamb. Tip into a deep dish.
Slice {{ing:potato-large}} thinly. Layer over the top. Dot with {{ing:butter-unsalted}}.
Cover. Bake 1 hour 30 minutes. Uncover. Bake 30 minutes more, until golden.

recipes.name: Salmon with leeks and mustard sauce

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Melt {{ing:butter-unsalted}} in an ovenproof pan. Slice {{ing:leek}}. Fry 8 minutes, until soft.
Stir in {{ing:creme-fraiche}} and {{ing:wholegrain-mustard}}.
Lay {{ing:salmon-fillet}} on top.
Bake 15 minutes, until the salmon flakes.
Squeeze over {{ing:lemon}}. Scatter with {{ing:fresh-dill}}.
Heat the oven to 200C. Peel {{ing:potato-large}}. Boil 20 minutes. Mash with a third of {{ing:butter-unsalted}}.
Simmer {{ing:cod-fillet}} and {{ing:haddock-smoked}} in {{ing:milk-whole}} 6 minutes. Lift out. Keep the milk.
Melt the rest of the butter. Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Add the milk slowly, stirring until thick.
Flake in the fish. Add {{ing:peas-frozen}} and chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}}. Tip into a dish.
Top with the mash. Scatter {{ing:cheddar-cheese}}.
Bake 30 minutes, until golden and bubbling.
Fry {{ing:thai-red-curry-paste}} in a large pan 1 minute.
Add {{ing:stock-vegetable}} and {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}}. Simmer 5 minutes.
Soak {{ing:rice-noodles-dry}} in boiling water for the time on the packet. Drain into bowls.
Add {{ing:king-prawns-raw}} and halved {{ing:pak-choi}} to the soup. Cook 3 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:fish-sauce}} and the juice of {{ing:lime}}.
Ladle over the noodles. Top with {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.
Heat the oven to 200C. Cook {{ing:penne-dry}} 2 minutes less than the packet says. Drain.
Melt {{ing:butter-unsalted}}. Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}} 1 minute.
Add {{ing:milk-whole}} slowly, stirring until thick.
Stir in most of {{ing:cheddar-cheese}} and {{ing:mustard-dijon}}.
Mix with the pasta. Tip into a dish. Top with halved {{ing:cherry-tomato}} and the rest of the cheese.
Bake 20 minutes, until bubbling.
Heat the oven to 180C.
Slice {{ing:potato-large}} thinly. Slice {{ing:leek}}.
Fry the leeks in {{ing:butter-unsalted}} 8 minutes, until soft.
Warm {{ing:double-cream}} with crushed {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}.
Layer potatoes, leeks and most of {{ing:cheddar-cheese}} in a dish. Pour over the cream.
Top with the rest of the cheese. Bake 1 hour, until tender and golden.
Cook {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} for the time on the packet.
Fry chopped {{ing:onion-medium}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} 8 minutes.
Add sliced {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}. Fry 8 minutes, until browned.
Stir in {{ing:smoked-paprika}}. Add {{ing:stock-vegetable}}. Bubble 3 minutes.
Take off the heat. Stir in {{ing:soured-cream}}.
Scatter with {{ing:fresh-parsley}}. Serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Root vegetable stew with herb dumplings

steps.instruction: Fry chopped {{ing:onion-medium}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} 8 minutes in a casserole.
Dice {{ing:carrot-medium}}, {{ing:parsnip}} and {{ing:swede}}. Add with {{ing:lentils-green-dry}}.
Add {{ing:stock-vegetable}} and {tomato-purée}. Simmer 25 minutes.
Mix {{ing:flour-self-raising}}, {{ing:suet-vegetable}} and chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}} with cold water to a soft dough.
Roll into 8 balls. Sit on the stew. Cover. Simmer 20 minutes, until risen and fluffy.
Cook {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} for the time on the packet.
Fry chopped {{ing:onion-medium}} in {{ing:vegetable-oil}} 8 minutes.
Add {{ing:garlic-clove}}, {{ing:ginger-fresh}} and {{ing:curry-powder}}. Fry 1 minute.
Add {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}}, drained {{ing:chickpeas-tinned}} and {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}}.
Simmer 15 minutes, until thick.
Stir in {{ing:spinach}} until wilted.

recipes.name: Plant sausage and bean casserole
recipes.method_note: Check the sausage packet says vegan; some plant sausages contain egg.

steps.instruction: Brown {{ing:plant-sausages}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} 6 minutes. Lift out. Slice.
Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}. Fry 8 minutes.
Add {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:smoked-paprika}}. Fry 1 minute.
Add {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}}, drained {{ing:butter-beans-tinned}} and {{ing:stock-vegetable}}.
Return the sausages. Simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:kale}}. Cook 4 minutes, until tender.
Peel and chop {{ing:potato-large}}. Boil 20 minutes, until soft.
Drain. Leave in the pan 2 minutes to steam dry.
Mash with {{ing:butter-unsalted}} and warm {{ing:milk-whole}}.
Season with {{ing:salt}}.
Shred half of {{ing:cabbage-white}} finely.
Fry {{ing:caraway-seeds}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} 30 seconds.
Add the cabbage and a splash of water. Stir-fry 6 minutes, until tender.
Squeeze over {{ing:lemon}}.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Quarter {{ing:parsnip}} lengthways. Toss with {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Roast 30 minutes.
Drizzle with {{ing:maple-syrup}}. Add {{ing:fresh-thyme}}. Roast 10 minutes, until sticky.
Peel and dice {{ing:swede}} and {{ing:carrot-large}}.
Boil 25 minutes, until soft.
Drain well. Mash with {{ing:butter-unsalted}}.
Season with plenty of {{ing:black-pepper-ground}}.
Cut {{ing:leek}} into 5 cm lengths.
Melt {{ing:butter-unsalted}} in a wide pan. Add the leeks.
Add {{ing:stock-vegetable}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}. Cover.
Simmer 15 minutes, until soft. Uncover and bubble 3 minutes to reduce.
Heat the oven to 180C.
Mix {{ing:flour-self-raising}}, {{ing:suet-vegetable}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Add {{ing:milk-whole}} to a soft dough.
Roll out to a 30 by 20 cm rectangle.
Spread with {{ing:jam-strawberry}}, leaving a border. Roll up from the short side.
Wrap loosely in greased foil. Bake 1 hour, until risen.
Slice. Serve with hot {{ing:custard-ready}}.
Heat the oven to 190C. Line a 23 cm tin with {{ing:shortcrust-pastry}}.
Bake 15 minutes with baking beans. Take them out.
Warm {{ing:golden-syrup}} until runny.
Stir in {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}}, the zest and juice of {{ing:lemon}}, {{ing:egg-medium}} and {{ing:double-cream}}.
Pour into the case. Lower the oven to 170C.
Bake 30 minutes, until set with a slight wobble.

recipes.name: Chocolate puddle pudding
recipes.method_note: It looks wrong going in. Trust it.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C.
Mix {{ing:flour-self-raising}}, 2 tbsp of {{ing:cocoa-powder}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}}.
Melt {{ing:butter-unsalted}}. Whisk with {{ing:milk-whole}} and {{ing:egg-medium}}. Stir into the flour.
Spread in a baking dish.
Mix {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}} and the rest of the cocoa. Sprinkle over. Pour 300 ml boiling water on top.
Bake 30 minutes. The sauce sinks to the bottom.
Heat the oven to 150C. Butter a baking dish with {{ing:butter-unsalted}}.
Put in {{ing:rice-arborio-dry}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}}.
Pour over {{ing:milk-whole}}. Grate over {{ing:nutmeg}}.
Bake 2 hours, stirring once after 30 minutes, until creamy with a golden skin.
Serve with a spoon of {{ing:jam-strawberry}}.
Put {{ing:sugar-caster}}, {{ing:water}}, {{ing:cinnamon-stick}}, {{ing:star-anise}} and pared zest of {{ing:orange}} in a pan.
Heat until the sugar dissolves.
Peel {{ing:pear}}, keeping the stalks. Lower into the syrup.
Simmer 25 minutes, turning, until a knife slides in.
Lift out. Bubble the syrup 10 minutes, until thick. Spoon over. Serve with {{ing:coconut-yoghurt}}.
Heat the oven to 180C. Line a 20 cm square tin.
Chop {{ing:dates-pitted}}. Simmer in {{ing:oat-milk}} 5 minutes. Stir in {{ing:bicarbonate-of-soda}}.
Beat half of {{ing:dairy-free-spread}} with 100 g of {{ing:sugar-muscovado}}.
Stir in the dates and {{ing:flour-self-raising}}. Spread in the tin. Bake 30 minutes.
Melt the rest of the spread and sugar with {{ing:golden-syrup}}. Bubble 2 minutes. Pour over.
Cut the peel and pith off {{ing:orange}}, {{ing:grapefruit}} and {{ing:clementine}}.
Slice into rounds. Lay on a plate.
Scatter with {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}} and {{ing:fresh-mint}}.
Drizzle with {{ing:maple-syrup}}.
Warm {{ing:milk-whole}} in a pan until steaming.
Break in {{ing:dark-chocolate}}. Whisk until melted.
Add {{ing:sugar-caster}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}}.
Pour into mugs.
Slice {{ing:ginger-fresh}}. Put in a pan with {{ing:water}}.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Add the juice of {{ing:lemon}} and {{ing:honey}}.
Strain into mugs.
Heat {{ing:water}} until steaming.
Divide {{ing:spirit-40}} and {{ing:honey}} between 4 mugs.
Stick {{ing:cloves}} into slices of {{ing:lemon}}. Add one to each mug.
Pour over the hot water. Stir.

recipes.name: Negroni
recipes.method_note: The spirit is gin; the vermouth sweet red.

steps.instruction: Fill a jug with ice.
Add {{ing:spirit-40}}, {{ing:vermouth}} and {{ing:bitter-aperitivo}}. Stir 30 seconds.
Strain over fresh ice in 4 glasses.
Add a strip of peel from {{ing:orange}}.
